errors.next: Change the highlighted value and try again.
errors.notFound: This item is gone or you can no longer see it. Reload the page.
errors.conflict: Something with the same value already exists.
errors.customFields: A custom field needs attention. Check the fields marked and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.reasonRequired: Write a reason for the move.
errors.fileTooLarge: Files can be up to 50 MB.
errors.fileScanning: The file is still being checked. Try again in a moment.

errors.cueLabel: Name the cue, for example House to Half.

rules.record_xyz_required: Choose a URID category or declare the XYZ tag.
rules.record_xyz_basis: Declare the XYZ tag to differ from the category.
rules.record_blocker_required: Name what blocks the record before marking it Blocked.
rules.record_replan_reason_required: Give a replan reason before deferring the record.
rules.record_transition_not_allowed: This move is not allowed from the record's state. Choose one of the offered moves.
rules.record_state_conflict: Someone moved this record first. Reopen it to see its state and try again.
rules.record_retained: Canceled records are kept, never moved to Trash.
rules.record_scope_project: Choose a scope node of the record's own project.
rules.transition_reason_required: Every move needs a reason. Write one and try again.
rules.dependency_cycle: That dependency would make the schedule circular. Choose another predecessor.
rules.dependency_project: Dependencies link records of the same project.
rules.baseline_locked: A locked baseline never changes. Capture a new baseline instead.
rules.reschedule_cycle: The schedule is circular here, so the record cannot move. Remove one of its dependencies first.
rules.reschedule_locked: This change would move a record that is complete or locked into a baseline. Move it less, or change the dependency.
rules.reschedule_canceled: This record is canceled, so it stays where it was on the timeline.
rules.reschedule_window: A record cannot end before it starts. Resize it the other way.
rules.reschedule_single_date: A record with one date can only move. Give it a start and an end to resize it.
rules.reschedule_undated: Give the record a date before moving it on the timeline.
rules.cue_already_called: That cue was already called. Call the next cue.
rules.cue_call_capability: You cannot call cues on this project. Ask the stage manager to call it.
rules.sheet_publish_capability: You cannot publish sheets on this project. Ask a producer to publish it.
rules.sod_work_order_award: Someone other than the work order's author must award it.
rules.work_order_award_unpriced: Record the bid's price before awarding it.
rules.work_order_award_withdrawn: A withdrawn bid cannot be awarded. Choose another bid.
rules.work_order_award_bid: Award a bid on this work order.
rules.work_order_award_rpc_only: Award the work order from one of its bids.
rules.work_order_transition_not_allowed: This move is not allowed from the work order's state.
rules.work_order_state_conflict: Someone moved this work order first. Reopen it and try again.
rules.work_order_retained: Only a draft work order can be deleted. Cancel it instead.
rules.bid_window_closed: Bids are recorded only while the work order is a draft or open.
rules.bid_withdrawn: A withdrawn bid stays withdrawn. Record a new bid instead.
rules.same_project: Everything you link must belong to the same project.
rules.sod_approval_requester: Someone other than the requester must decide this approval.
rules.approval_decided: A decided approval is final. Raise a new approval instead.
rules.approval_not_eligible: Only someone who may edit this project's records can decide its approvals.
rules.time_zone_unknown: Choose a time zone from the list.
rules.engagement_cue_artist_only: Set times belong to artist engagements. Choose an artist.
rules.engagement_cue_project_mismatch: That artist is engaged on another project. Choose an artist of this show's project.
rules.shift_empty: Select at least one record to shift.
rules.shift_too_large: This shift moves more than 500 records with their successors. Shift fewer at a time.
rules.place_dated: This record already has dates; drag its bar instead.
rules.cue_called: A called cue keeps its time. Clear it from the selection.
rules.cue_move_called: A called cue keeps its place. Move an uncalled cue instead.
rules.cue_move_before_called: Cues move only after the last called cue. Choose a later place.
rules.cue_standby_called: That cue was already called, so it cannot go on standby. Choose an uncalled cue.
rules.cue_standby_capability: You cannot put cues on standby on this project. Ask the stage manager to do it.
rules.cue_shift_range: Nudge the plan by up to an hour earlier or later.
rules.cue_call_kind: Calls go to Audio, Lighting, Video, Special Effects or Stage. Choose one of those departments.
rules.project_day_split_limit: A day splits into at most four parts. Change or remove one first.
rules.project_day_scope_kind: A day serves a show of the project. Choose a show, or leave it for the whole project.
rules.project_day_time_zone: This show's venue sets the time zone. Leave the time zone empty.
rules.project_day_project_immutable: A day stays in its project. Add the day to the other project instead.
rules.grid_empty: Type at least one row before saving.
rules.grid_too_large: A grid saves at most 200 rows at a time. Save in parts.
rules.grid_incomplete: Someone added or removed a cue. Reload the running order and edit it again.
rules.grid_kind: Choose a record kind for the new row.
rules.bulk_stale: Someone changed this row after you loaded it. Reload to see the change.
rules.day_template_title: A record item's title follows its kind's grammar.
rules.day_template_too_large: A day template holds at most 500 items. Remove some first.
rules.day_template_item_window: An item is more than a day from this day or lasts longer than a day, so a day template cannot hold it.
rules.day_template_run_ambiguous: This day has more than one running order. Choose the one to use.
rules.day_template_run_unknown: Choose a running order of this project.
rules.day_template_unknown: Choose a day template of this organization.
rules.anchor_unset: Set the project's anchor day before moving it.
rules.anchor_too_large: This move would move more than 2000 records. Move the plan in parts.
rules.anchor_show_started: A cue of this project has been called, so its shows have started and stay on their dates.
rules.anchor_sheet_collision: A published sheet already covers the day an unpublished one would move to.
rules.anchor_pinned_pushed: This move would push a record that is pinned to its dates.

errors.shiftMinutes: Enter whole minutes other than 0, up to seven days either way.
errors.cueCall: Each department's call can be up to 2000 characters. Shorten it and save again.

grammar.Approval: A noun phrase naming what is approved, for example Rigging Plan Sign-Off.
grammar.Booking: A noun phrase naming the reservation, for example Crew Hotel Block.
grammar.Build: Start with a verb: name the installation, for example Install the Truss.
grammar.Compliance: A noun phrase naming the document on file, for example General Liability Certificate.
grammar.Contract: A noun phrase naming the agreement, for example Venue Lease.
grammar.Deadline: A noun phrase naming the item owed, for example Final Rider.
grammar.Decision: A noun phrase naming the choice, for example Headliner Set Time.
grammar.Distribution: A noun phrase naming what goes out, for example Press Release.
grammar.Document: A noun phrase naming the artifact, for example Rigging Plan.
grammar.Event: A proper title in Title Case, for example Opening Night on the Pier.
grammar.Goal: State the result as reached, for example Sell-Through Achieved.
grammar.Inspection: A noun phrase naming the check, for example Fire Marshal Walk.
grammar.Meeting: A noun phrase naming the conversation, for example Production Meeting.
grammar.Milestone: State the condition as true, for example Stage Load-In Complete.
grammar.Payment: Start with a verb: name the movement of money, for example Pay the Deposit.
grammar.Permit: A noun phrase naming the instrument, for example Special Event Permit.
grammar.Recruitment: Start with a verb: name the role filled, for example Hire Stage Managers.
grammar.Rehearsal: Start with a verb: name the run-through, for example Run the Full Show.
grammar.Report: A noun phrase naming the publication, for example Event Recap.
grammar.Risk: A noun phrase naming the exposure, for example Generator Failure.
grammar.Shift: Write role · block, for example Stagehand · Load-in.
grammar.Strike: Start with a verb: name the load-out, for example Strike the Main Stage.
grammar.Supply: A noun phrase naming the item received, for example Bar Ice.
grammar.Task: Start with a verb, for example Verify the Rigging Plot.
grammar.Timeline: A noun phrase naming the window, for example Load-In Window.
grammar.Training: Start with a verb: name the session, for example Train the Ushers.
